title: Storage class
purpose: Review one storage class and the units that use it.
summary: One storage class and the units that use it.

tasks.title: Change the class
steps: Admin and manager: select [[Edit]], change it and give a reason.

tasks.title: Open a unit of this class
steps: Select its code under Storage units.

good_to_know: Up to the first 100 units are listed, active and retired alike.
The code is fixed and never reused.
Classes are never deleted. Clear Active to stop offering one.

items.label: Active storage units
items.description: Number of active units of this class.

sections.title: Storage units
paragraphs: Up to the first 100 units of this class, by code, active and retired alike (the header says when more exist). Each shows code, name, room and status.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin and manager roles. Opens the class form.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The newest 50 recorded changes to this record, shown oldest to newest, each with its time, the person and the reason given. Setup entries carry no reason. History cannot be edited or deleted.
